pages.text: The $(item)Bug Net$() turns any arthropod you strike into a specimen. Spiders and other common arthropods become plain specimens.$(br2)A specimen shows the living bug, and keeps its colour and markings.
The $(item)Bug Jar$() holds many bugs at once.$(br2)Hold it up to an arthropod to capture it. Press it against a block to let the last bug go, or crouch while doing so to free them all.
